answer: The bedrock check is Telescopemaker tube proof attested before the eclipse tally. Under it sits 3-year night-watch service, 65 supervised sightings, night-watch exam, annual tally, and no template can dig around it. Minutes add up the same way: 18 for one, 6822 for 379, and the farm pays in afternoons it never gets back. Judge it by the hollow: open, checkable, and older than the reward. Judge it by the velvet: real money, real time, gone before any payout. Judge it by the willow: a file that outlives the farm. Per identity, per alias, per epoch: the bill always arrives, and it always adds up.
